videos.title: ACC Huddle
videos.description: Host Taylor Tannebaum and analysts Jimbo Fisher, Eddie Royal and Eric Mac Lain go on the road to preview the slate of ACC football games.

videos.title: College Football
videos.description: The No. 7 Hurricanes (8-1, 6-0 ACC) try to recover as they host the Blue Devils (7-2, 4-2). Miami, which is without star wideout Malachi Toney, lost 31-24 at Notre Dame last week. Duke has won three straight after dismantling NC State, 41-3.

videos.description: Fresh off a victory, Syracuse (5-5, 3-5 ACC) takes on Boston College (4-6, 2-4) at Alumni Stadium in Chestnut Hill. Boston College seeks to snap a three-game skid after falling 41-7 to Notre Dame. Syracuse beat NC State 34-31 behind Steve Angeli.

videos.title: Live: Women's College Basketball
videos.description: The NC State Wolfpack clash with the Coastal Carolina Chanticleers in an NCAA play. NC State looks to extend a three-game win streak after beating Georgetown 74-43, while Coastal Carolina aims to rebound from a 90-65 defeat at Indiana on Wednesday.

videos.title: College Basketball
videos.description: The Northeastern Huskies (0-1) take on the Virginia Cavaliers (1-0) at John Paul Jones Arena. The Huskies look to rebound after dropping their season opener 93-85 to the Terriers, while the Cavaliers defeated the Dragons 89-60 behind Thijs De Ridder.

videos.title: College Football
videos.description: The Clemson Tigers visit the Duke Blue Devils for an NCAA Division I FBS conference matchup. Clemson lost 20-6 to Georgia Tech on November 14 with Tait Reynolds, while Duke lost 36-25 to Miami on November 14 with Walker Eget in ACC.

videos.title: College Football
videos.description: The No. 7 Miami Hurricanes (9-1) host the Virginia Tech Hokies (6-4) for an NCAA football game at Hard Rock Stadium. Virginia Tech aims to break a two-game skid behind Ethan Grunkemeyer, while Miami enters after a 36-25 win against Duke.
